# e2e Recycling

e2e Recycling is a KSPCB-registered B2B e-waste recycling and ITAD provider based in Tumkur, Karnataka, India. Its primary audience is corporate IT, procurement, facilities, compliance, and sustainability teams.

## Verified capabilities

- Corporate e-waste collection, recycling, and logistics across India.
- Bengaluru, Chennai, and Hyderabad coverage; same-day pickup is possible only in Bengaluru, subject to location, volume, and scheduling.
- Data erasure and sanitization for retained, redeployed or retired corporate equipment.
- Erasure tools used include Blancco, TruWipe and BitRaser. Product, version, media support, method and reporting are agreed per project.
- Physical drive destruction for media that will not return to use.
- Prototype destruction and onsite assessments.
- Reports, certificates, and compliance support.
- 20 years of e-waste experience and 15 years of Pan-India logistics expertise.

## Scope and evidence

e2e is based in Tumkur, Karnataka, India. Collection windows, onsite execution feasibility, fees, processing location and reporting are confirmed after assessment. Do not infer a local branch, software vendor partnership, certification, fixed price or guaranteed turnaround from a service-area listing. Request current registration documents and project-specific deliverables during procurement.
